# Scoped Animations

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Change color and scale together, then restrict animation to the scale modifier so the unrelated color update remains immediate on the same symbol.

- Before: Scale and color animate
- After: Only scale animates

APIs: `animation(_:body:)`, `scaleEffect`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present ScopedDoExample() in your app.
struct ScopedDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            ScopedDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct ScopedDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .largeTitle
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        Image(systemName: "shippingbox.fill")
            .font(font)
            .foregroundStyle(phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? Color.blue : Color.orange)
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth) { content in
                content.scaleEffect(phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 1 : 1.4)
            }
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
